portInfo.description: SeaDays lists Rügen as its own catalog obligation, but the live directory card redirects to sassnitz-mukran-germany. This guide therefore describes the island product and points landings to facilities published by Mukran Port / Fährhafen Sassnitz GmbH, without inventing a third terminal or merging port_id values. Mukran’s sea-port cruise facts table compares Mukran Port vs Sassnitz City Harbour (quay counts, LOA/draught, city distances, tendering rules). Tourism copy places the port ~12 km south of UNESCO Nationalpark Jasmund and lists Binz, Putbus, Kap Arkona and Stralsund as excursion geography.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Rügen island cruise landing (see Sassnitz / Mukran)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: From Mukran, plan a coach/taxi for the 6.5 km into Sassnitz or onward to Jasmund/Binz. From City Harbour, centre is 0.6 km. Exact shuttle products are line-dependent and not verified here.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Nationalpark Jasmund / chalk coast — long call; transfer from Mukran required.
Sassnitz mole / harbour — short call if berthed at City Harbour.
Binz / Kap Arkona — coach timing not verified.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask whether the ship uses Mukran or Stadthafen Sassnitz — city distance differs by ~6 km.
